t: This is the Foreign Office building in Westminster, a government office building. It was designed by two architects. Sir George Gilbert Scott was a prolific Gothic Revival architect, who began his career designing workhouses and went on to design or alter over eight hundred buildings. Alongside him, Sir Matthew Digby Wyatt, a British architect and art historian, is credited with the design. Wyatt had been Secretary of the Great Exhibition and was the first Slade Professor of Fine Art at Cambridge. Together they shaped what you see in front of you.
